chose: The deploy's gate counts a container as ready by exiting only when its restart policy is `no` and it exited 0, so a one-shot such as dashboard-builder can be in the release; any other exit, or an exited container under another policy, still fails and rolls the release back.
options: Teach the gate one-shots: restart `no` and exit 0 is ready, in the PR that adds dashboard-builder to the release
Keep dashboard-builder out of the release and building on home until a later story teaches the gate
Mark one-shots apart in the release and skip them in the gate
gray: RL11 knew only healthy and running a minute with no restart, written when every released service was long-running; nothing said how a one-shot is judged. Deferring kept a build on home, a second way onto it, and left the one-way deploy waiting on another story. Skipping one-shots would let a failed dashboard build pass unseen and adds a second kind of release entry.
undo: Revert the judge change and take dashboard-builder out of the release (restore its build: and the guard's named exemption).
